summary.text: Glenn Lancaster is the Republican candidate for the Oregon State Senate, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Courtney Neron (D/Working Families Party) and Tim Nelson (Libertarian). A retired business owner, he advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Lancaster graduated from Hackettstown High School and lists business ownership as his career experience.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired business owner, husband, grandfather and 35-year Oregon resident who served the electric utility industry for 40 years and became involved in his community after retiring in 2020.

Lancaster's three listed campaign messages were lowering the cost of living by opposing tax increases and changing housing policy, holding state leadership accountable for results, and enforcing public safety laws and improving school outcomes.
